verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented power envelope specs (TDP, voltage, thermal design) from NVIDIA's own docs, and no independent performance-per-watt benchmarking; only scattered community mentions of a 600W per-card draw and total 2.4kW multi-GPU power needs, plus skepticism that a competing part uses 'half the energy' for similar output. missing for 10: official TDP/power-envelope documentation, independent perf-per-watt benchmarks, sustained-workload thermal/power testing data.
